title: Test LangGraph interrupt/resume tracing and lifecycle managers with version-gated skips
answers: how to test langgraph interrupt tracing in mlflow
test langgraph callback manager without tracer
skip langgraph test on old python or langgraph version
body:
Langgraph autolog tests live in tests/langgraph/test_langgraph_autolog.py. The interrupt test (test_langgraph_interrupt_and_resume_do_not_log_tracer_errors) is parametrized sync/async; the async case is skipped with sys.version_info < (3, 11) because interrupt() does not work with ainvoke before 3.11.
Check for tracer errors by capturing logs with caplog.at_level(logging.WARNING) and filtering records containing "MlflowLangchainTracer", then assert traces with get_traces() have OK status.
Lifecycle-manager tests use pytest.importorskip("langgraph.callbacks") because that module exists only in langgraph >= 1.1.8; they call the public get_sync/async_graph_callback_manager_for_config helpers and assert no MlflowLangchainTracer in handlers.
The tests were verified across langgraph 1.2.11, 1.1.8, 1.1.6 and 0.6.7, so keep version gates rather than pinning one version.
applies: Writing or running tests under tests/langgraph/ that depend on LangGraph interrupt or callback-manager behavior.
says: Pausing and resuming interactive workflows produces tracer error messages in the execution logs.
Interrupted workflow runs do not display an OK status on the trace details page.
Tracing breaks when human-in-the-loop agents resume asynchronous execution after an interrupt.
Ensure graph workflow traces complete cleanly without logging tracer warnings on resume.
search: Testing LangGraph interrupt/resume tracing and callback lifecycle managers in tests/langgraph/test_langgraph_autolog.py requires version-gated skips across Python and LangGraph versions. Interrupt tests verify warning logs lack MlflowLangchainTracer errors and traces from get_traces() have OK status, skipping async cases on Python below 3.11. Lifecycle manager tests use pytest.importorskip('langgraph.callbacks') for versions 1.1.8 and above, asserting no MlflowLangchainTracer exists in callback manager handlers.
